lesson.introText:
Hey guys! I’m BUDDY! Today, we’ll work on three words that fluent speakers reduce almost to nothing. They’re... …HIM, HER, THEM! Fluent speech attaches them to the verb: meet them

Reducing them is not lazy speech: it is what puts the stress on the right word. Pronouncing them in full sounds emphatic, as if you were correcting someone.

conversation.question: A: How did you get that partnership?
modelAnswers: B: I approached him at a conference.
